text_block_list.text:
On my way to go shopping, a group of horse 
girls came walking in my direction...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Aww, man... If only I had gotten a hit 
during that chance in the 8th inning, we 
would've won~...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
It's my fault, really. My error in the 
bottom of the 9th led right to those 
runs...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we hold a review session 
together! Maybe over some Hachimi drinks, 
what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Umm... well... I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry! Looks like I forgot something! 
I'll go back and get it, so the three of 
you go on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: See ya later then!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, there she goes. Shall we go grab 
some Hachimi ourselves then?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahhh...! I forgot something too! I need 
to go grab it...!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Ines too~~? Guess Hachimi will have 
to wait for next time then!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that when I was the one who 
brought it up! Well then, see you later~!

The two seemed to head under the elevated 
tracks, but... I'm worried about Mejiro 
Ryan's state.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright... First, 100 throws against the 
wall!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryaaan-chan. Did you find what you left 
behind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Why are you here...? Uhh, well, 
that's—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I suddenly really wanted to play 
catch! Would you mind playing with me, if 
that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, let's do it!

While playing catch, the two remained 
silent. For a while, only the sound of the 
ball echoed back and forth—
(*Thwack...*)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ryan-chan! I want you to throw it 
baaack!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I really can't help feeling frustrated. 
Giving up that walk-off two-run homer in 
the bottom of the 9th...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Why did I throw such an easy meatball...? 
The more time passes, the angrier I get at 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can accept losing if I stretch my pride! 
But what frustrates me most is that I 
didn't practice hard enough to leave no 
regrets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaargh! I'm so pissed!! I wanna practice 
more, and get way better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I won't let anyone hit it! No 
way in hell!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Next time's the charm!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, could you throw the same pitch you 
got hit on today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eh, but you don't even have gear on... If 
it turns into a wild pitch, it's 
dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll catch whatever you throw at me. Trust 
me on this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Got it! Then I'm putting everything 
I've got into it!

Mejiro Ryan took a deep breath, and took a 
big... massive wind-up—
(*Whiiizzzzz—SMACK!!*)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Not sharp enough! That's getting crushed! 
Come on, put more muscle into it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines... Alright! I'm gonna keep throwing 
until I'm fully satisfied!!

The fighting spirit in both of them blazed 
brightly. ...The day they seize victory 
doesn't seem far away.
